video_title: 'I put in so much work these past six months' - Klay Thompson on his strong 💪 | SportsCenter

quotes.speaker: Klay Thompson
quotes.summary_phrase: Klay Thompson on the Miami Heat's recent team chemistry and success
quotes.excerpt: I'm seeing guys with no agenda playing unselfish basketball on both ends of the floor.
quotes.quote: I'm seeing guys with no agenda playing unselfish basketball on both ends of the floor. I'm seeing our frontcourt really forming one of the best duos in the NBA. The run Giannis Antetokounmpo is on right now is incredible and you take it for granted what he can do on a nightly basis. The same with Bam Adebayo getting his footing and how to play off a talent like him. It's been a fun turnaround for these last nine games, but we're not content and we want to continue this win streak on Wednesday.

quotes.speaker: Klay Thompson
quotes.summary_phrase: Klay Thompson on his role and fitting in with Miami's stars
quotes.excerpt: It's about allowing your best players to be the best version of themselves.
quotes.quote: It's about allowing your best players to be the best version of themselves, especially when you're playing a certain role. We know Bam Adebayo and Giannis Antetokounmpo are two leaders and it's on the rest of us to see how we fit in around them. For myself, it's about spreading the floor, being ready to shoot at all times, being pesky on defense, switching screens, boxing guys out and doing the little things. When those two get going, it's so much easier for everybody else, including myself, to get open looks from the perimeter and just be ready to knock them down.

quotes.speaker: Klay Thompson
quotes.summary_phrase: Klay Thompson credits training staff for his current physical shape
quotes.excerpt: I put in so much work these past six months to get in the best shape possible.
quotes.quote: I'm hungry and I'm not satisfied. I've experienced some incredible moments in my basketball life, but I came here to Miami to experience more and create memories that I'll hold dearly for the rest of my life. I'm fortunate to have the start I have this season because I put in so much work these past six months to get in the best shape possible. I give so much credit to the training staff and the athletic training department of our organization. These guys and girls got me in such great shape and they hold me accountable every day to be my best self.

quotes.speaker: Klay Thompson
quotes.summary_phrase: Klay Thompson on the legacy of Ray Allen and Reggie Miller
quotes.excerpt: I have so much respect for Ray and Reggie for off-ball two-guard like myself.
quotes.quote: I have so much respect for Ray Allen and Reggie Miller for off-ball two-guard like myself. Those two guys really laid the blueprint for what it is to be a great shooter and great scorer playing off off-ball actions. Obviously they were great with the ball in their hands; they make some of the most clutch shots in NBA history. It would be such a surreal feeling to pass Ray. It's something I couldn't even have dreamt of as a kid and I'll get emotional just talking about it because it's such an incredible feat of mine.

quotes.speaker: Klay Thompson
quotes.summary_phrase: Klay Thompson reflects on his career and historical impact
quotes.excerpt: I knew I had a chance to make the NBA when I was growing up.
quotes.quote: I would think he'd say, wow, you really exceeded what you thought you could become. I knew I had a chance to make the NBA when I was growing up, but not to make such an imprint historically. Being in the record books, being on the list with the best players that ever play, it's truly an honor.

quotes.speaker: Klay Thompson
quotes.summary_phrase: Klay Thompson on his love for the Grand Theft Auto series
quotes.excerpt: I've been playing GTA since it was the bird's eye view on the original PlayStation.
quotes.quote: I've been playing GTA since it was the bird's eye view on the original PlayStation. I'm 36, but I'll still be gaming when I get this version. The story mode of this game is maybe the best in all of gaming, so I'm excited when that game does come out. It would feel much better to have a day of gaming when we get that victory on Wednesday.
